T.printHint: Tip: in the print window choose “Save as PDF”. Sign before sending.
T.ch_bussgeld: Fine: the objection (Einspruch) must be sent in writing (by letter) within 2 weeks of delivery – a simple email is not enough. Print it via “As PDF / print”, sign it and send it in time.
T.ch_gericht: Court payment order (Mahnbescheid): best object with the enclosed form by post to the court (Mahngericht) – an email is not enough. Deadline: 2 weeks from delivery.
T.ch_steuer: Tax office: the safest way to object is via ELSTER (Mein ELSTER → Einspruch) or signed by post. Deadline: 1 month.
T.ch_behoerde: Attention: for an objection (Widerspruch) to the Jobcenter, Familienkasse, health insurance or an authority, a simple email is not enough (Federal Social Court, 2025). Print, sign and send it by post, fax or via the official online portal. The deadline is usually 1 month.
T.ch_firma: With companies (e.g. invoice, contract) an email is usually enough. Keep the sent email and ask for a confirmation.
T.ch_kuendigung: Cancellation: an email is usually enough (text form). Ask for a confirmation and keep the email.
T.ch_mail: You can send this reply by email if the sender gives an email address. Keep the sent email.
T.payHint: Scan with your banking app (photo or QR transfer). Check the details before sending.
T.ibanBad: The IBAN seems to be wrong – please check it in the details below.

T.budgetKids: Only adults can see the budget.
T.budgetSetup: Enter your income – then you will see what is left after all the bills.
T.wStartSub: Just speak – in English too. Mailcut turns it into a proper German email.
T.wSub: Just say what should be in it – in English, German or mixed. Mailcut writes a proper German email from it.

T.wTo: To (email address – you can also add it later)
T.wSay: What do you want to say?
T.wSayPh: Say or write it the way you speak. For example: “I can't come on Tuesday, my son is ill. I need a new appointment.”
T.wListening: I'm listening … Just speak normally. Tap “Finished” when you have said everything.
T.wKbHint: Tip: you can also tap the microphone on your phone keyboard and speak.
T.wCheck: This is what the email says – is that right?
T.wWhyNoAuto: Mailcut never sends anything on its own. Voice input sometimes mishears – especially numbers, dates and names. A quick look before sending protects you from mistakes.
T.wChangePh: e.g. “shorter”, “friendlier” or “also write that I have already paid”
T.wEmpty: First say or write what should be in the email.
T.wMailHint: Your email app is open – everything is filled in. Read it over quickly and tap Send.
T.wMailHint2: No email app opened? Then tap “Copy text” and paste the text into your email.
T.wFromLetter: Reply in your own words (also by voice)
T.wCostHint: Each version counts as one AI help.
T.wMicDenied: The microphone is not allowed. You can type or use the microphone on your keyboard.
T.wPrivacy: With voice input, your browser turns speech into text (depending on the device, e.g. via Google or Apple). Mailcut does not store any recordings. We only send your text to the AI to rewrite it.
T.mStartSub: Read them, get them explained in English and reply by voice
T.mWebOnly: Connecting your mailbox works in the web app at app.mailcut.de.
T.mWhy: Then you see your emails here, get them explained in English and reply directly from Mailcut – from your own address.
T.mProvPick: Which provider? (e.g. for your own domain)
T.me_input: Please enter your email address and app password.
T.mSafe: Safe: only you see your mailbox in Mailcut – not even your family. The app password is stored encrypted. Mailcut only reads emails when you open them here, does not store them and changes nothing in your mailbox. You can disconnect at any time.
T.mOutlook: Outlook, Hotmail and Live no longer allow app passwords since September 2024. This will come later with a Microsoft sign-in. Until then: paste the email under “Reply to an email” and send it from your email app.
T.mDiscQ: Really disconnect the mailbox? The app password will be deleted from Mailcut. Your emails stay with your provider.
T.mNoTo: Please enter an email address under “To”.
T.mConnectHint: Tip: connect your mailbox under “Emails” – then Mailcut sends the email directly.
T.mReconnect: The connection to your mailbox no longer works (e.g. because the app password was deleted or your password was changed). Please connect again.

T.me_smtpauth: Reading works, but sending was rejected. With GMX and WEB.DE you need a separate app password for email programs (see instructions).
T.me_network: The mail server cannot be reached right now. Please try again later.
T.me_unknown: I do not recognise this provider automatically. Please choose it from the list.
T.me_limit: A lot of emails have already been sent today. It will work again tomorrow.
T.me_to: The email address under “To” was rejected. Please check it.
T.me_server: The mail server reported an error. Please try again later.
T.me_generic: That did not work. Please try again.
T.mg_gmail: How it works with Gmail: 1. In your Google account, turn on “2-Step Verification”. 2. At myaccount.google.com/apppasswords create an app password named “Mailcut”. 3. Paste the 16-character code here.
T.mg_gmx: How it works with GMX: 1. In your GMX mailbox, allow access under Settings → “POP3/IMAP Abruf”. 2. Under Security, create an app password (anwendungsspezifisches Passwort) for “Mailcut”. 3. Paste this password here.
T.mg_webde: How it works with WEB.DE: 1. In your WEB.DE mailbox, allow access under Settings → “POP3/IMAP Abruf”. 2. Under Security, create an app password (anwendungsspezifisches Passwort) for “Mailcut”. 3. Paste this password here.
T.mg_tonline: How it works with Telekom: in the Telekom customer centre, under Email, set a “password for email programs” and enter it here (not your normal Telekom login).
T.mg_yahoo: How it works with Yahoo: in your account settings under Security, create an app password and paste it here.
T.mg_icloud: How it works with iCloud: in your Apple Account settings under “Sign-In and Security”, create an app-specific password and paste it here.
T.mg_generic: Use your email password. If two-factor sign-in is switched on with your provider, you need an app password instead.

vollstreckungsbescheid.s: The court has issued an enforcement order – with it the creditor can have your account or wages seized.
todo: Check immediately whether the claim is correct
Not justified: lodge an objection (Einspruch) with the court within 2 weeks
Justified: pay or agree on instalments – a debt advice service (Schuldnerberatung) helps for free
vollstreckungsbescheid.ign: After 2 weeks the order becomes final – then your account or wages can be seized.

mahnbescheid.s: At a creditor's request, the court (Mahngericht) has sent a payment order. The court does not check whether the claim is correct.
todo: Check immediately: is the claim justified?
Not justified: send an objection (Widerspruch) with the enclosed form to the court within 2 weeks
Justified: pay or agree on instalments with the creditor
mahnbescheid.ign: Without an objection, an enforcement order (Vollstreckungsbescheid) follows – after that, seizure is allowed.

inkasso.s: A debt collection company is demanding money for another creditor – often for a forgotten bill.
todo: Check: do I know this claim? Is the amount right? Has the bill perhaps already been paid?
Justified: pay or ask for instalments – this keeps further costs low
Not justified: object in writing and enclose proof; if in doubt, ask the consumer advice centre (Verbraucherzentrale)
inkasso.ign: Next could be a court payment order (at least €38 court fees) and possibly a negative SCHUFA credit entry.

jobcenter.s: A letter about citizen's income (Bürgergeld) or unemployment benefit – for example an appointment, a request for documents or a decision.
todo: Always attend appointments or cancel them in advance
Hand in the requested documents on time (Jobcenter.digital or by post)
Decision wrong? Object (Widerspruch) within 1 month – in writing, not by a simple email
jobcenter.ign: Missed appointments can lead to benefit cuts; decisions become final after 1 month.

familienkasse.s: The Familienkasse checks the right to child benefit and often asks for proof, for example a school or training certificate.
todo: Send the requested proof within the deadline – online to the Familienkasse or by post
Write the child benefit number (Kindergeldnummer) on every page
Keep a copy or a photo
familienkasse.ign: Without proof, the Familienkasse can stop child benefit and demand back money already paid (€259 per child per month).

bussgeld.s: A warning or fine procedure, usually because of a traffic offence. In a hearing (Anhörung) you may give your side; the fine notice comes later.
todo: Check: are the date, place, number plate and driver correct?
Warning fee (Verwarnungsgeld): pay within the given deadline – then the case is closed
Fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid): pay or object in writing within 2 weeks
bussgeld.ign: After 2 weeks the fine notice becomes final. Then come reminders and enforcement, possibly penalty points in Flensburg.

kfz.s: Customs (Zoll) sets or demands the vehicle tax – usually once a year by direct debit.
todo: Check the amount and due date
Best: give a SEPA direct debit mandate
Mistake (e.g. car already deregistered)? Tell the main customs office (Hauptzollamt) – objection within 1 month
kfz.ign: Late payment surcharge of 1% per month; if you do not pay, the car can be deregistered by force.

steuerbescheid.s: The tax office (Finanzamt) has set your tax – with a refund or an additional payment.
todo: Compare the assessment with your own tax return (income, deductions, children)
Transfer any additional payment by the date given
Found a mistake: object (Einspruch) within 1 month – via ELSTER or signed by post
steuerbescheid.ign: After one month the assessment becomes final. Tax paid late costs a 1% late surcharge per month.

steuer_abgabe.t: Tax office: submit your tax return
steuer_abgabe.s: The tax office (Finanzamt) is reminding you to submit a tax return or is asking for documents.
todo: Note the submission date
Submit the tax return via ELSTER or ask a tax adviser or an income tax help association (Lohnsteuerhilfeverein)
If you cannot make it: ask for an extension in time
steuer_abgabe.ign: For every started month of delay there can be a late filing surcharge of at least €25, plus a penalty payment.

rundfunk.s: The broadcasting fee (formerly GEZ) is paid per home. The Beitragsservice asks for a payment or information or tells you about changes.
todo: Check the contribution number and amount
Pay or set up a direct debit
If you receive Bürgergeld, BAföG or similar benefits: apply for an exemption
rundfunk.ign: After 4 weeks of arrears a late surcharge is added (1%, at least €8), later reminders and enforcement.

krankenkasse.s: A letter from your health insurance – for example about contributions, benefits, family insurance or a decision.
todo: Check whether it is a decision with information on legal remedies (Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung)
Send the requested information (e.g. income for family insurance) on time
Decision wrong? Object (Widerspruch) within 1 month – in writing
krankenkasse.ign: Decisions become final after 1 month; unpaid contributions cost late surcharges.

nebenkosten.s: The yearly statement of service charges from your landlord or the property management.
todo: Check the billing period and how costs are split (floor area, number of people)
Pay the additional amount or look at the receipts first
Objections are possible up to 12 months after receipt
nebenkosten.ign: The additional payment is usually due 30 days after receipt; after that, reminders and default interest may follow.

energie.s: The bill from your energy supplier: consumption, additional payment or credit, and the new monthly instalments.
todo: Compare the meter reading with your own photo or note
Pay any additional amount by the due date – a credit is usually transferred or offset
Check the new instalment so there is no big additional payment next year
energie.ign: First comes a reminder; with larger arrears later a warning that supply will be cut off.

mahnung.s: According to the sender, a bill has not been paid yet.
todo: Check whether it has already been paid (bank statement, direct debit)
Justified: pay immediately
Not justified: object in writing and enclose proof of payment
mahnung.ign: Default interest, debt collection (€30.90 even in the simplest case) and a court payment order may follow.

schule.s: A letter from school or nursery – often dates, payments, consent forms or replies.
todo: Put the date in the calendar
Sign the reply slip and give it to your child
Pay money (e.g. for the class trip) by the date
schule.ign: Your child may, for example, not be able to go on the trip or may miss something important.

RULES.verwaltung: Decision of an authority – objection (1 month)
RULES.sozial: Health insurance, Jobcenter, pension – objection (1 month)
